{"design":"# Plan: mimid-1wgh.4 — mimi-mls (MLS adapter over OpenMLS)

Approved by Mark 2026-10-17. Sources: protocol-06, mls-extensions-10, barnes-mls-appsync-01, mls-ratchet-tree-options-01, mahy-mls-semiprivatemessage-07, RFC 9420; openmls 0.9.1 crate source.

## Mark's decisions
- Patch OpenMLS (small, ~40 lines) on our own branch off v0.9.1 via [patch.crates-io] so the hub can send AppDataUpdate as an external proposal. Upstream later.
- SemiPrivateMessage deferred (protocol-06 L1468 makes it optional); handshakes go as PublicMessage.
- mls-rs cross-check: dev-dependency from git, pinned commit d9af950.
- Storage: openmls_sqlite_storage, exact pin.
- Stale "Application" component label in openmls: note now; report upstream together with our patch (Mark approves text).

## 1. AppSync vs AppDataUpdate
AppSync is a stale name for the same mechanism. appsync-01 §9 ApplicationDataUpdate == ext-10 §4.7 AppDataUpdate (same invalid/update/remove enum and rules; still carries stale `component_states`); appsync-01 §10 ApplicationData == ext-10 §4.8 AppEphemeral. protocol-06 uses "AppSync" at L295, L407, L489, L582, L655-712, L889-903 (§4.2), L1360 (§5.3), L1462 and "AppDataUpdate" at L983 (§4.3.2), L1686 (§5.4), L3063 (§7.5), L3173 (§7.6), citing both drafts. L1361's "applicationId of mimiParticipantList or mimiRoomPolicy" matches no field (both use component_id) and no registered name; protocol-06 §10 registers participant_list 0x0022 and room_metadata 0x0023; room-policy-04 §10.1 registers policy components.
=> DR-1: every "AppSync proposal" is an ext-10 §4.7 AppDataUpdate (proposal type 0x0008); mimiParticipantList -> participant_list 0x0022; mimiRoomPolicy -> room-policy-04 §10.1 components.

## 2. Gap analysis (openmls 0.9.1 + extensions-draft)
| Feature | Status | Evidence | Path |
|---|---|---|---|
| app_data_dictionary (ext 0x0006) | Present | extensions/app_data_dict_extension.rs, Extensions::app_data_dictionary() | Public API |
| AppDataUpdate (0x0008) from member | Present | messages/proposals/app_data_update.rs; ProcessedMessageContent::UnresolvedAppDataCommit -> AppDataDictionaryUpdater -> stage_app_data_commit/resolve_app_data_commit (mls_group/processing.rs:758, public_group/process.rs:206-245) | Public API |
| AppDataUpdate from external sender | MISSING | ExternalProposal only new_group_context_extensions/new_remove/new_add; MlsGroup (processing.rs ~L1112) and PublicGroup (process.rs ~L400) return UnsupportedProposalType otherwise; same on master | Patch |
| AppEphemeral (0x0009) | Present, unused | AppEphemeralProposal | n/a |
| Safe AAD | Partial (-09 semantics) | framing/safe_aad.rs builds prefix+tail; -10 says whole authenticated_data is SafeAAD | Wrapper: never set_aad when safe_aad_required(); reject non-empty tail_aad() |
| Component operation label | Stale | component.rs:260 uses b"Application"; -09/-10 use "MLS Component" | Unused by protocol-06; record, don't patch |
| Last-resort KeyPackage | Stale | ext type 10 (extensions/mod.rs:281); -10 makes it component 0x0004 in KeyPackage app_data_dictionary | Public API |
| SemiPrivateMessage | MISSING | WireFormat only 1-6; needs crate-private SecretTree handshake key/nonce + new ProtocolMessage variant | Fork-scale; DEFERRED |
| ratchet-tree-options | Missing, buildable | VerifiableGroupInfo::new(...) public; PublicGroup::group_context()/confirmation_tag()/export_ratchet_tree() public | Public API; wire structs in mimi-mls |
| External senders + external Add/Remove | Present | ExternalSendersExtension, ExternalProposal::new_remove/new_add | Public API |
| External commits | Present | MlsGroup::join_by_external_commit, ExternalCommitBuilder; inline allowlist includes AppDataUpdate (public_group/validation.rs:553) | Public API |
| PublicGroup processing | Present (PublicMessage only) | PublicGroup::from_external, process_message (PrivateMessage -> IncompatibleWireFormat), merge_commit | Public API |
| SignWithLabel / EncryptWithLabel | Sign public; encrypt pub(crate) | ciphersuite::signable, SignContent::new; hpke::encrypt_with_label | Re-implement via OpenMlsCrypto::hpke_seal |

-09 -> -10 deltas affecting protocol-06: Safe AAD unsafe tail forbidden (affects frank_aad); safe_aad + app_components mandatory once app_data_dictionary supported; AppAck and GREASE in AD/AE removed; component registry §7.6 -> §7.5.

## 3. Public API sketch
```rust
pub struct Identity;   // BasicCredential + Ed25519 signer, suite 1 fixed
pub struct Member;     // wraps MlsGroup (agent)
pub struct Observer;   // wraps PublicGroup (hub/follower)
pub type ComponentId = u16;
pub enum Incoming { Application{sender, data}, Proposal(..), Commit(CommitSummary) }

Identity::generate(name) / key_package(&self, last_resort: bool) -> Vec<u8>
Member::create(id, group_id, external_senders, components: &[(ComponentId, Vec<u8>)]) -> Member
Member::join_welcome(id, welcome, tree: Option<&[u8]>)
Member::join_external(id, group_info, tree) -> (Member, Vec<u8>)
Member::commit(&mut self, adds: &[&[u8]], removes: &[u32], app_updates: &[AppUpdate]) -> CommitBundle
Member::process(&mut self, msg, apply: impl FnMut(ComponentId, Option<&[u8]>, &[&[u8]]) -> Result<Vec<u8>>) -> Incoming
Member::send(&mut self, data, safe_aad: &[(ComponentId, Vec<u8>)]) -> Vec<u8>
Member::component(&self, id) -> Option<&[u8]>
Observer::from_group_info(group_info, tree) / process(..) / merge()
Observer::propose_app_update / propose_remove   // external sender; needs patch
Observer::group_info(&self, partial: PartialGroupInfo) -> Vec<u8>; ratchet_tree() -> Vec<u8>
sign_with_label / verify_with_label / encrypt_with_label / decrypt_with_label
```
RatchetTreeOption and PartialGroupInfo wire structs live in mimi-mls.

## 4. Test oracles
| Feature | Oracle |
|---|---|
| sign/encrypt_with_label | mlswg crypto-basics.json (vendored from ~/GIT/openmls/openmls/test_vectors) |
| Base group ops, Welcome/commit | cross-validate vs mls-rs (independent), git dev-dep @ d9af950 |
| PublicGroup commit handling | passive-client-handling-commit.json fed into Observer |
| AppDataUpdate / SafeAAD / PartialGroupInfo encoding | hand-encoded bytes from spec TLS-PL structs (ext-10 §4.6-4.9, rto-01 §3-4), written independently of the code |
| Safe AAD -10 strictness | negative: SafeAAD + trailing byte must be rejected |
| GroupInfo reconstruction | signature verifies under committer leaf key; matches GroupInfo exported by an mls-rs member |

## 5. Decision records (filed)
DR-1 AppSync = AppDataUpdate. DR-2 Safe AAD per ext-10. DR-3 franking_signature_key 0x0021 == franking_agent (FrankingAgentData). DR-4 rto-01 httpsUri/httpsUrl same arm value 2. DR-5 GroupInfo reconstruction uses new epoch after hub merges commit. DR-6 external_senders: hub only in v1. DR-7 SemiPrivateMessage ambiguities recorded, feature deferred.

## 6. Risks
- OpenMLS extensions-draft code is a moving target; every pin bump re-runs DR-2 and last-resort tests.
- Our openmls patch must be rebased on each bump until upstreamed.
